items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Adam Lombay and Naveel, my cousin, who used to play.

ctx.x: I wondered on the plantation up there, if there were many people just played guitar and would sing the blues by themselves?
Yeah, I used to have Adam Lombay, Adam Lombay and Naveel, my cousin, who used to play.
Did they do that before you started, or after you were a musician?
